summary: Fluent expression API with BaseExpressionAPI, BooleanExpressionAPI, namespace descriptors (.str, .dt, .name, .struct, .list), and factory functions (col, lit, when, coalesce, today, now, etc.). 36 Python files providing method-chaining interface that builds backend-agnostic AST nodes. Mirrors Polars conventions per polars-api-substrait-ast principle.

key_classes.name: BooleanExpressionAPI
key_classes.purpose: Primary user-facing expression API with operator overloads, 20+ flat namespace builders, 5 explicit namespace descriptors (.str, .dt, .name, .struct, .list)

key_classes.name: BaseExpressionAPI
key_classes.purpose: Abstract base holding _node, providing __getattr__ dispatch and create() factory

key_classes.name: NamespaceDescriptor
key_classes.purpose: Python descriptor for lazy namespace binding (.str, .dt, etc.)

key_functions.name: t_col(name, unknown=...)
key_functions.purpose: Ternary-aware column reference with custom sentinel values

extension_points: New flat namespace builder class in _FLAT_NAMESPACES
lifecycle_notes: today() and now() free functions added 2026-05
Substrait builders in substrait/, extension builders in extensions_mountainash/
API mirrors Polars conventions per polars-api-substrait-ast principle
